artworks.title: Edwin Booth
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Ronald and Kathleen Perisho
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated sideways with his hands on his lap. He is looking to his left, away from the camera. The man has distinct facial features, with a pronounced nose and deep-set eyes. He has dark, shoulder-length, slightly wavy hair and is wearing a suit jacket over a white shirt with a bow tie. The background is plain, and the image is bordered with decorative lines.

artworks.title: George Inness
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a man from the waist up. He is seated, with his body slightly turned to one side and his head facing forward. The man has medium-length wavy hair that falls around his ears and a beard with a mustache. He is wearing round wire-rimmed glasses, a dark suit jacket over a white shirt, and a dark bow tie. The jacket is buttoned, and a chain is visible across his vest. The background is plain and neutral. The border at the bottom of the photograph includes the photographer's name, "Brady," and the location, "New York."

artworks.title: Hiram Powers
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man standing next to a white marble bust on a fluted pedestal. The man has his hands behind his back. He has a mustache and beard, a serious expression, and is wearing a cap. He is dressed in a long coat over a three-piece suit with a waistcoat, patterned tie, and high-collared shirt. He is not wearing any visible jewelry and is not holding any objects. His shoes are polished and match his formal attire. The background appears to be a plain setting, possibly a studio, with a carpeted floor featuring an ornate pattern. The image has a sepia tone quality.

artworks.title: The Politics and Poetry of New England
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two men sitting indoors. The man on the left is sitting in a wooden chair, facing the man on the right. He has light-colored hair, is wearing a dark jacket, vest, shirt, necktie, and lighter-colored trousers. The man on the right has a fuller beard and mustache, with medium-length hair, and is wearing a dark three-piece suit. A small table with two books on top is placed between them. The background is plain with a textured surface.

artworks.title: Louis Agassiz
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a man standing in profile but slightly turned towards the camera, dressed in formal attire and holding a piece of chalk. He is gesturing towards a chalk drawing on the wall that resembles a stylized biological or botanical illustration.

artworks.title: Gustave Courbet
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on a chair, leaning slightly to his right. He has one hand on his thigh and the other holds a painter's palette on his lap. He has a beard and mustache, styled hair, and is smoking a pipe. He wears a light-colored shirt with rolled-up sleeves and dark trousers, holding a paintbrush. Beside him, an easel displays a painting of potted plants and flowers. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Giuseppe Verdi
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated in an ornate wooden chair. He is facing forward with his legs crossed, one hand resting on the chair's arm. The man has a composed expression with a neatly groomed beard and mustache, and his hair is combed back. He is wearing a dark double-breasted suit with a white shirt and a tie. To his left is a richly carved table with books on top, and a portion of draped fabric is visible behind it. The background is plain, emphasizing the man and the furniture elements around him.

artworks.title: Eugène Delacroix
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, facing slightly right. He has a prominent brow, mustache, and chin beard. His medium-length hair is styled in waves, parted on the side. He is wearing a dark, buttoned-up coat with a high collar and a scarf or cravat at the neck. His left hand is partially visible at his side, in the pocket of his coat. The background is plain with a neutral tone. The words "Legé & Bergeron" are printed at the bottom of the photograph.

artworks.title: Ernest Meissonier
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in the doorway of a room. He is holding a palette and paintbrushes, with one hand on his hip, looking to his left. The man has a beard and mustache, short combed-back hair, and is wearing a loose coat and checked trousers. A large dog is lying at his feet. Nearby, there is an easel with an unfinished painting of horses and riders. The interior space also includes a chair with a cane back and a chandelier with unlit candles. Natural lighting and an open door leading to an outdoor area complete the scene.

artworks.title: Germon's Temple of Art
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a building facade, specifically the entrance to Germon's Temple of Art located at 914 Arch Street. The image captures a mid-19th century urban streetscape, highlighting a grand architectural structure with a richly decorated facade. The building features a large arched entryway flanked by ornate columns and intricate embellishments. Above the entrance, the name "Germon's Temple of Art" is prominently displayed, accompanied by classical architectural details such as cornices and decorative motifs. The shop windows on either side exhibit framed items, possibly photographs or artworks, suggesting the establishment's purpose as a venue for art and possibly photography. The photograph, with its sepia tone and detail, conveys the historical context and architectural style of the period.

artworks.title: Grotecloss Photographic Gallery, New York
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a historical city street corner with a photographic gallery and a dry goods store. The image shows a two-story building with a wooden exterior, prominently advertising "PHOTOGRAPHIC ROOMS" and "W.M.G. GROTECLOSS PHOTOGRAPHER" with additional signs indicating services like copying daguerreotypes and creating photographs in various styles such as India ink and oil. A large American flag drapes down the side of the building. Below, on the ground floor, the open-fronted shop appears to specialize in "DRY GOODS" with fabrics and other merchandise displayed for sale. The scene includes a horse-drawn cart parked on the cobblestone street in front of the building.

artworks.title: Montgomery,  Alabama
artworks.description: The image shows a vintage photograph of a street scene with a large building in the distance crowned by a dome. A decorative circular fence with two posts is visible in the foreground, along with business signage. There are rows of buildings with uniform facades on either side of the street, with multi-story buildings, awnings, horse-drawn carriages, and pedestrians. The overall tone of the image is sepia, evoking a historical ambiance reminiscent of the late 19th century.

artworks.title: Collins Photography Studio, Urbana, Ohio
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a storefront building with signage and various items outside. The photograph depicts a two-story wooden structure with a large sign at the top reading "G.W. Collins." On the side of the building are advertisements for "PHOTOGRAPHS, ALBUMS, FRAMES, & MATERIALS." The first-floor facade features two distinct sections: one labeled "CINCINNATI GROCERY" over its entrance, and the other labeled "G.W. COLLINS" over the adjacent entrance. People are gathered outside both entrances, and various goods such as barrels and sacks are displayed around the entrances. The building has several windows, and there are photo portraits hanging as advertisements on the walls. The ground in front appears uneven, with several posts in the foreground and a small animal near one of them. The style of the building and clothing suggest an earlier historical era. The photograph captures the bustling atmosphere of a small-town commercial district from this period.

artworks.title: Central Park
artworks.description: The image shows a frozen lake in Central Park with figures skating. The view is from a higher vantage point, capturing a wide expanse of the scene. Dark silhouettes stand out against the ice surface. The horizon shows distant bare trees and a large building. The black and white photography creates a classic feel with strong contrast. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray and sepia. The upper half of the frame is a light sky.

artworks.title: Central Park
artworks.description: The image shows a winding road curving from the right side towards the center. The view is from the road level, revealing grassy slopes with rocks and small boulders on either side. The horizon is high in the image where the hills meet the sky. The sky is pale, suggesting clear or lightly overcast weather. The image is in sepia tone and appears to be an early photographic print.

artworks.title: Flag Raising, Girls School, Lawrence, Massachusetts
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a three-story building with people on the roof. The image shows a large wooden structure with evenly spaced windows featuring shutters. The architecture includes a porch supported by several columns. The roof is lined with a group of figures standing. A small structure on the rooftop holds a flag. A dirt path leads to the main entrance, bordered by grass and small shrubs. There are visible wheel tracks near the building, and in the background, there are other structures and blurred trees.

artworks.title: M'Elheny Farm and Bennihoof Run
artworks.description: The image shows a sepia-toned landscape with a river in the foreground. On the opposite side of the river, there is a treeless hill with bare trees along the horizon. Various wooden derricks and industrial structures are scattered across the landscape, suggesting a historical industrial site. The water in the foreground is still, contrasting with the industrial scene in the distance. The sepia tone gives the image a vintage look, emphasizing earthy tones of brown, beige, and gray.

artworks.title: Chicago Court House
artworks.description: The image displays a stately building captured from a slightly elevated or aerial viewpoint, situated diagonally across the frame. The building has a prominent central dome and intricate facade. It is positioned on a corner within a fenced area, surrounded by smaller structures and additional buildings. The image, captured in sepia tones, features detailed brushstrokes that create subtle gradations of light and shadow, emphasizing the architectural elements. In the foreground, several people are visible walking on the pavement or gathered in small groups.

artworks.title: A.J. Porter Ambrotype Studio
artworks.description: The image shows five men outdoors beside a wooden structure with a sign that reads "AMBROT." Two men are seated on chairs, one of them holding a piece of paper. Three other men are standing nearby, one leaning against the building, one to the left of the seated men, and another on the right holding a long object. The men wear various period clothing, including vests, jackets, and hats. In the foreground, there is a pile of firewood. A canvas tent is pitched to the right, and in the background, there is an open area with a horse-drawn wagon and a large tree. The scene is in sepia tone.

artworks.title: Ambrotype Rooms, Winchendon, Massachusetts
artworks.description: The image depicts a street view from a slightly elevated perspective, focusing on a row of connected buildings. The structures have wooden facades, evenly spaced windows, and signs for businesses like "HARDWARE," "Ambrotype Rooms," and "S.A.& B. SMITH." A group of men stands in front of the hardware store, next to a horse-drawn wagon facing left. Additional shops along the street have signs for "HARNESS, SADDLES & TRUNKS" and "BONNET ROOM." The horizon blends into the buildings with slanting roofs and chimneys. The photograph's sepia tones enhance its historical ambiance, suggesting a late 19th or early 20th-century American town. The focus is on the architecture and figures, with no visible sky or landscape elements, capturing a moment of stillness on an unpaved street.

artworks.title: Rower
artworks.description: The image shows a person rowing a long boat on a calm body of water, with sailboats scattered in the background. A cityscape is visible on the elevated horizon, reflecting in the water. The sky is overcast, creating a muted light over the scene. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones.

artworks.title: Town Scene
artworks.description: The image shows a village among hills. A line of trees decorates the horizon behind the village. A brick building stands out in the center, possibly a school or a municipal building. Closest to the viewer are wooden houses with pitched roofs and a few smaller outbuildings. The colors are sepia, creating a warm atmosphere. The composition leads the eye from the houses to the wider view of the village and hills, ending at the horizon with trees in silhouette.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Ronald and Kathleen Perisho
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a relaxed pose with both hands in the pockets of his coat. He has a prominent beard and mustache, and his hair is concealed beneath a tall top hat. The man is dressed in a formal suit consisting of a vest, trousers, and a long dark overcoat. A watch chain is visible hanging from his vest. To his right, there is an ornately carved chair with a cushioned seat and chair back. The background is plain, possibly consisting of a painted wall, with patterned carpet on the floor beneath him. The name "Brady" along with "Washington" appears at the bottom of the photograph.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman from the waist up, facing slightly to her right with her body turned sideways and her face towards the camera. She has a neutral expression, delicate facial features, dark, center-parted hair, and wears a high-collared, long-sleeved checkered dress with decorative elements on the sleeves. She holds an open book on her lap with one hand while the other hovers above it. The background is plain with a soft, neutral tone.
